exposure: various sonographic estimated fetal weight (sEFW) formulas
cohort: The study included 274 term breech-presenting fetuses and 274 matched term vertex-presenting fetuses.
finding: While overall sonographic estimated fetal weight (sEFW) prediction accuracy was slightly superior in vertex-presenting fetuses, there was no statistical difference in prediction accuracy for small-for-gestational age (SGA) or large-for-gestational age (LGA) between breech and vertex presentations.
cross-section timing: Sonographic measurements were performed within 3 days of delivery.
birth_weight: Participants were matched by birth weight; outcomes related to small-for-gestational age and large-for-gestational age.
gest_age: Term pregnancies; participants were matched by gestational age.
